sections.title: Predictable Patterns
sections.content: CRUD (Create, Read, Update, and Delete) is the standard for data operations. By enforcing this pattern, any developer can understand a controller regardless of the resource it handles.

examples.code:
| Action | Internal Key | Controller Method | HTTP Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Read All | readAll | getAll | GET |
| Read One | readOne | getOne | GET |
| Create | create | create | POST |
| Update | update | update | PUT |
| Delete | delete | remove | DELETE |
